capabilities: create columns from a text line, a supported block, or a selection
add, resize, swap and delete columns with the mouse
equalize column widths and undo changes through editor history
render column groups in Live Preview and Reading view
store column content and widths in easy-columns fenced blocks
disambiguation: Not a table or spreadsheet tool; it lays out note content in side-by-side columns rather than editing tabular data.
extras: The directory listing warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The interface defaults to Russian, with English selectable in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to place text and images side by side in a note while keeping the content as plain Markdown.
summary: Mouse-driven tool that creates and arranges column layouts in notes, storing content and widths as Markdown inside easy-columns fenced blocks.
